tool_args.rationale: The paid trajectories show history dependence despite matched endpoints, and the added batch brings the data to eight rows. Fit all four parameters numerically, reconstruct the initial memory state from the irregular, time-shifted prefix, and use RK4 for the horizon evolution; no high-frequency chaotic-sign evidence warrants abstention.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Eight trajectories now provide the prescribed minimum to fit the four coupled-memory ODE parameters; another probe is not justified before fitting and confirmation.
The observed endpoint-matched history gaps and coupled transient lag are inconsistent with a history-independent single-mode snapshot mechanism.
The transient-lag signature and the short forecast horizon relative to the memory scale favor fitting the supplied full two-state history-conditioned ODE rather than its reduced approximation.
